name: Veg Burger
description: Crispy veggie patty with lettuce, tomato and house sauce.

instructions.text: 1. Toast the burger bun until golden.
2. Pan-fry the veggie patty for 4-5 minutes per side.
3. Layer lettuce, tomato and sauce on the bun.
4. Add the patty and serve hot.

name: Veg Meal
description: A wholesome combo of rice, dal, sabzi, roti and salad.

instructions.text: 1. Cook rice and dal separately until soft.
2. Prepare the mixed vegetable sabzi.
3. Roll and cook the rotis on a hot tawa.
4. Plate everything together with fresh salad.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy rice crepe filled with spiced potato masala.

ingredients.text: Sambar and coconut chutney to serve

instructions.text: 1. Prepare the potato masala with onions and spices.
2. Spread the batter thin on a hot griddle.
3. Add the masala filling and fold the dosa.
4. Serve hot with sambar and chutney.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
description: Classic pepperoni pizza on a crispy thin crust.

instructions.text: 1. Spread tomato sauce evenly on the pizza base.
2. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese generously.
3. Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
4. Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Pizza
description: Loaded chicken pizza with bell peppers and cheese.

instructions.text: 1. Spread BBQ sauce on the pizza base.
2. Top with shredded chicken and bell peppers.
3. Cover generously with mozzarella cheese.
4. Bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until golden.
